description: Lookup field. Pulls values from a record in ANOTHER flow. Captured as Type:"Reference" with a Field::QueryDefinition node whose FlowType is "Process" (this is the ONLY thing that distinguishes a Lookup from a Remote lookup — see field_remote_lookup.json, FlowType "Dataset"). Captured live headless via copilot 2026-08-12 (field sweep #46); ids de-identified.
notes: Type is "Reference" (NOT "Lookup"). The lookup behavior lives in the Field::QueryDefinition child node, not the field Type.
QueryDefinition.LHSModel = the referenced flow's id; FlowType "Process" = it references a Process flow. LookupField = the columns pulled across.
The referenced flow must EXIST before this field is written (build order: master data / the referenced process first).
Per-field lookup/reverse-lookup runtime routes are a known 500 dead-end (CLAUDE.md Item data plane) — do not probe them.
